_schema.purpose: Pin canonical JSON serialization across Rust and TS.
_schema.format: Newline-delimited JSON. Each line is either this schema object (first line only) OR a vector object: {"name": str, "input": <any>, "canonical": <utf8 string>}. The `canonical` field is the EXACT byte sequence the implementation must produce when serializing `input`.
rules: Numbers per ECMA-404 + IEEE 754 round-trip; in signed payloads we restrict to integers
null is `null`; absent fields are OMITTED (never serialized as null)
String escapes minimal: only control chars (\u00XX, lowercase hex), `\"`, and `\\`

name: key sort places capitals before lowercase (ASCII)
unicode strings (BMP + supplementary) emitted as raw UTF-8
omitted-null vs explicit-null (object null fields disappear)
string escaping (control chars use \u00XX, quote+backslash use shortform)
array order is preserved (canonical JSON does NOT sort arrays)
camelCase keys (typical attn schema) sort deterministically
unit separator (U+001F) — highest control char that gets escaped
